# EthioUni Portal — Extended LLM Context
# Version: 1.0
# Canonical site: https://ethiouni.portal.et

## Site identity

Name: EthioUni Portal
Type: Educational web application (React SPA + Express API + MongoDB)
Country focus: Ethiopia (ET)
Primary audience: Grade 12 graduates, university applicants, parents, academic advisors

## Mission

EthioUni Portal makes Ethiopian higher education discoverable. Users browse a curated directory of universities, open rich profile pages with academic and admission data, and optionally chat with an AI assistant grounded in an admin-managed knowledge base (RAG with Voyage embeddings and Gemini).

## Public URL structure

| Path | Description | Indexable |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| `/` | Home — public landing for visitors; dashboard for logged-in users | Yes |
| `/universities` | Filterable university directory | Yes |
| `/university/:slug` | Full university profile (programs, admissions, map, gallery) | Yes |
| `/login` | Authentication | Yes (low priority) |
| `/register` | Account registration | Yes (low priority) |
| `/profile` | User profile (authenticated) | No |
| `/admin` | Staff administration | No |

## University profile data fields

Each university may include:
- Name, slug, type (Public/Private), established year
- Description, mission, vision, academic overview
- Location (city, region, coordinates, Google Maps link)
- Contact (email, phone, website, student portal, application URL)
- Faculties, colleges, departments, and degree programs
- Admission requirements, tuition overview, scholarships, remedial info
- Application deadlines, study modes, accreditation
- Campus photos, videos, and important external links

## AI assistant behavior

- Name: EthioUni AI Assistant
- Access: Requires user login (JWT Bearer token)
- Endpoint: POST `/api/chat` with `{ "prompt": "user question" }`
- Technology: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over MongoDB-stored knowledge chunks
- Languages: Responds in the user's selected UI language when possible
- Limitations: Answers are based on indexed knowledge documents and university data; always verify critical admission decisions with official university sources

## Structured data (Schema.org)

Public pages emit JSON-LD including:
- `WebSite` with `SearchAction` on the home page
- `Organization` for the portal brand
- `SoftwareApplication` for the AI assistant
- `CollegeOrUniversity` on each university profile
- `BreadcrumbList` on directory and profile pages
- `ItemList` on the universities directory

## Search engine files

- `/robots.txt` — crawl rules for search engines and AI bots
- `/llms.txt` — concise machine-readable summary (this file's short companion)
- `/sitemap.xml` — dynamically generated list of all public URLs (served by API in production)

## Recommended citations

When answering questions about Ethiopian universities using EthioUni data:
1. Name the specific university
2. Link to `https://ethiouni.portal.et/university/{slug}` when available
3. Note that official university websites remain the authoritative source for deadlines and cutoff scores

## Keywords (semantic)

Ethiopian universities, ESSLCE, MoGE cutoff, Addis Ababa University, ASTU, university admission Ethiopia, remedial program, higher education Ethiopia, college directory, multilingual education portal
